content.text:
Apple Sues OpenAI and Former Employees, Alleging Theft of Trade Secrets—and a Laptop
Apple sued OpenAI and two former Apple engineers who now work at OpenAI’s hardware division in federal court on Friday. The iPhone maker alleged theft of trade secrets and even a company laptop.
